```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(lubridate)
library(svglite)
library(kableExtra)
library(showtext)

setwd(here::here())

#font_add_google("IBM Plex Sans", "ibm")
extrafont::loadfonts()
week_sel=11

pretty_table <- function(x){
  kable(x) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"),
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left"
    )
}

source("scripts/league_data.R")
```

[See all the recaps for the 2026 season](https://jshannon75.github.io/pcfl/)

It's hard to believe, y'all, but there are only FOUR more weeks left in the regular season.

## Week `r week_sel` Headlines

* Another week, another shootout! (But the result is flipped.)
* The last playoff spot is officially up for grabs
* Can the Sharks sink the Seniors' hot streak?

## Last week's games

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(lastweek_results)
```

It wasn't in the cards last week, but the Henry's (Ted/Elaine) managed to score just enough in ANOTHER shootour with the Jaheims (Evan) to get the W this week. Thankfully, the GOAT (Jacob) was just underwhelming enough to keep me from taking the week's lowest score.

## Best performances

### Best players overall
Here's last week's **10 best performing players.** 

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(top_n(starters,10,Points) %>%
        arrange(-Points))
```

Dak Prescott with 36 points. On the bench.

### Best bench
Who won the **best scoring bench** award last week?

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(starter_benchteam %>% 
        arrange(-`Bench points`) %>%
  rename(Team=`PCFL Team`))
```

#### Season bench standings

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
pretty_table(starter_benchteam_all %>%
         arrange(-`Bench points`) %>%
 rename(Team=name))
```

The Sharks (Sarah) are pulling away again. This award should just have her name on it.

### Waiver masters

I've tallied the players picked up by each team since the draft and the points they've contributed as starters. Here's where those stand.

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(roster_pickup %>%
        select(-abbrev) %>%
        rename(Team=name,Points=draftpoints,
               Transactions=draft_num) %>%
        mutate(`Points/transaction`=round(Points/Transactions,1)) %>%

        arrange(-Points)) 
```

### Recapping the draft
Here's the amount of points drafted players have contributed to each team as starters.

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(roster_draft %>% 
         select(-abbrev) %>%
        rename(Team=name,Points=draftpoints) %>% 
        arrange(-Points))
```

At this point, the Sharks and Henry's are really the class of the league. The draft is everything, it turns out.

## Looking ahead

### League standings

Our league standings are a little unusual. We rank teams based on points, kinda like hockey. There are two ways to get points:

* Win your weekly matchup (1 point)
* Finish in the top six point scorers (1 point)

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(standings)
```

With four games left, it's too early to talk in definites, but that last playoff spot is now definitely up for grabs. The Jaheims, Seniors, Pigskin, and Sasquatch all with a shot. The Seniors specifically are on a hot streak. 

### Playoff Odds

I've created 10,000 simulations of the remaining matchups based on teams' performances so far. Here's what playoff odds look like based on those results:

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(playoff_odds %>%
  mutate(
    Odds      = scales::percent(PlayoffOdds, accuracy = 0.1),
    TopSeed   = scales::percent(TopSeed, accuracy = 0.1),
    AvgSeed   = round(AvgSeed, 2),
    ExpPoints = round(ExpPoints, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Team = name, Odds, TopSeed, AvgSeed, ExpPoints))
```

### This week's matchups

```{r}
pretty_table(nextwk1)
```
